dogecoin.text: Trump-backed American Bitcoin Corp. secured a $314 million deal for Chinese computer chips, and Gemini has filed for a Nasdaq IPO despite a $282 million loss. Grayscale is seeking SEC approval for a Dogecoin ETF (ticker: GDOG).
- MAGACOIN FINANCE, a deflationary DeFi project, has raised $12.5M in presale with projected 8,500% ROI, outpacing Ethereum, Cardano, and Dogecoin.
